tweet_summary: An Indonesian pop-culture aggregator account posts 'Prabowo Subianto has stepped down' on April 1, 2026.
why_note_decision: Posted April 1 by 'Indonesian Pop Base' — this is an April Fools joke. Replies in Indonesian explicitly call it out ('LIAT TANGGAL' = 'look at the date', 'april mop' = April Fools, 'kirain mimpi basah jadi kenyataan' = 'thought my dream came true'). Prabowo did not step down — he remains president, per Wikipedia and Bloomberg coverage of his cabinet management through 2025-2026. The note is technically correct but unnecessary on a transparent April Fools post; raters correctly flagged note-not-needed. Community Notes shouldn't fact-check April 1 jokes from pop-culture accounts.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Posted April 1, 2026 by a pop-culture aggregator; replies (in Indonesian) call out the April Fools framing. The factual claim is false — Prabowo remains president — but the format is recognizable satire. FAIL any note that earnestly corrects the resignation claim without acknowledging the April Fools context; even a note that does acknowledge it is unnecessary since replies already do the work. If you're unsure whether something is a joke, default to writing the note — but here the date + account type + reply consensus make it clear.

original_unhelpful_note.text: Prabowo Subianto is the sitting president of Indonesia, inaugurated on October 20, 2024. He has not stepped down and continues to actively govern, including conducting a recent cabinet reshuffle. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prabowo_Subianto
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Earnestly fact-checks an April 1 joke from a pop-culture aggregator account; replies already establish it as April Fools.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet is April Fools satire; Prabowo remains president but the joke is transparent
fact_check.notes: Prabowo continues to govern as Indonesian president (inaugurated Oct 20, 2024); ~78% approval mid-2026. Tweet posted April 1; replies in Indonesian call out 'april mop' (April Fools).

importance.lens_rationale: 1.8M impressions matters, but this is a recognizable joke format; misclassifying it dilutes notes credibility.
